matrix.source: independent copy of Q-SCF saved charge
same D-SCF final n_out; same common potential/core

stops: 48^3 insufficient for actual same-k G-Gprime or Nyquist: BLOCKED_GRID; do not enlarge
Estimated or measured peak >=8 GiB: RESOURCE_BLOCKED
Band tail fails at24: stop; no automatic extension
Actual convergence or numerical failure: retain original output; no parameter retry
Dependent fixed-density task requires successful bound parent SCF; missing parent BLOCKED
Any interrupted process inspected before decisions; no duplicate launch

null.formula: W=(V_uu+V_dd)/2; V_null=I_spin tensor W; Wz=(P_u D P_u^H z + P_d D P_d^H z)/2
null.independent_check: (V+sigma_x V sigma_x+sigma_y V sigma_y+sigma_z V sigma_z)/4
null.meaning: fixed-density diagnostic only; no scalar UPF, no scalar SCF, no QE scalar equivalence
null.common_density_core: identical to D full; no context block replacement

nlcc.formula: n_core(G)=single_core_radial(|G|)*sum_atoms exp(-i G.R_atom), with native DFTK normalization
nlcc.double_count: integral n_valence*vxc only; frozen core XC convention unchanged

grid_memory.product_support: enumerate actual per-k integer G; extrema of differences must lie strictly inside +/-24; no fit/cropping
grid_memory.storage: sequential k, reuse solver; conservatively account retained orbitals/projectors and all FFT workspaces
grid_memory.implementation: Opt-in one-k lazy FFT collection passed to the unchanged density accumulator, preserving summation order and old eager default. SCF and energy forward the new memory-only option.

gates.qe_spectrum: native CG1e-13Ry normal exit/no unconverged target warnings; threshold not explicit residual

grouping.diagnostic_occupations: evaluate FD using each parent SCF global mu; never impose8electrons at each probe
grouping.reference: one Gamma upper quartet mean per program for every probe; no per-k/per-band fitting
grouping.background: 44meV literature scale is not a threshold or fit target; no spatial irreducible representation computed

native QE XML/stdout sanitized with distinct hashes
